gold: Pyomyositis of the levator scapulae muscle caused by Fusobacterium necrophorum

selector.rationale: The presence of a poorly defined collection in the left paraspinal musculature on CT and an intramuscular abscess in the left levator scapulae muscle on MRI, along with the patient's symptoms and laboratory results, best support the diagnosis of Paraspinal abscess.

rejected.label: Cervical lymphadenitis
rejected.why: Less specific evidence and lower score

rejected.label: Fusobacterium necrophorum infection
rejected.why: Although the microbiological culture was positive for F necrophorum, the clinical presentation and imaging findings are more consistent with Paraspinal abscess

rejected.label: Pyogenic infection
rejected.why: Too broad, as Paraspinal abscess is a more specific diagnosis that explains the patient's symptoms and findings
